title: Bank Payment Journey
note: Exported from the AIW V5 reference project (illustrative content, not production architecture).

objects.title: Bank customer
objects.description: Submits an instruction and needs to understand its current outcome.

objects.title: Operations analyst
objects.description: Investigates held instructions and uncertain settlement outcomes.

objects.title: Initiate payment
objects.description: The customer submits an instruction with a destination, amount, and request reference.

objects.title: Screen the instruction
objects.description: Screen the instruction and choose whether to allow or hold it.

objects.title: Record the posting
objects.description: Record the authorised financial effect with the existing request reference.

objects.title: Settle the payment
objects.description: Submit the external leg and track a confirmed or uncertain response.

objects.title: Communicate the outcome
objects.description: Expose the known status and the next action to the customer or operations.

objects.title: Accept a traceable payment instruction
objects.description: The service shall accept a valid instruction and return a stable request reference.

objects.title: Hold an instruction that needs review
objects.description: The service shall hold an instruction that requires additional screening and expose its reason.

objects.title: Prevent duplicate financial effects
objects.description: The service shall recognise a repeated instruction reference and preserve one financial effect.

objects.title: Retain an uncertain settlement outcome
objects.description: The service shall keep an uncertain response pending until an enquiry resolves it.

objects.title: Notify the customer quickly
objects.description: The service shall notify the customer quickly after the payment outcome is known.

objects.title: Preserve one financial effect
objects.target: Return the recorded outcome and prevent an additional debit.

objects.title: Keep instruction intake available
objects.target: Accept the instruction or return an explicit unavailable response without losing its reference.

objects.title: Acknowledge a payment predictably
objects.target: Return the accepted reference or an explicit hold response. This measures acknowledgement, not final settlement.

objects.title: Resolve uncertainty without unsafe retries
objects.target: Keep the payment pending, enquire about its status, and assign unresolved cases for investigation.

objects.title: Reject an unauthorised instruction
objects.target: Reject the operation and record the attempted access without exposing payment details.

objects.title: Retain the payment trail across boundaries
objects.target: Retrieve correlated events and the recorded outcome using the original reference.

objects.title: When should the customer receive a payment acknowledgement?
objects.description: Separate acceptance of an instruction from final settlement. Compare response time, durable handoff, and operational complexity.
objects.question: When should the customer receive a payment acknowledgement?

objects.title: Where should one financial effect be enforced?
objects.description: A timeout, network retry, or repeated instruction must be evaluated at the authoritative posting boundary.
objects.question: Where should one financial effect be enforced?

objects.title: What should happen after an uncertain settlement response?
objects.description: The external operation may have succeeded even when the response is missing. Compare safe investigation with an immediate retry.
objects.question: What should happen after an uncertain settlement response?

objects.title: Channel & customer
objects.description: Instruction intake and communication.

objects.title: Control & accounting
objects.description: Risk decisions and authoritative financial records.

objects.title: Settlement
objects.description: External handoff and outcome investigation.

objects.title: Payment API
objects.description: Receives payment instructions, validates their shape, and assigns a traceable request reference. It coordinates the journey through downstream responsibilities.

objects.title: Risk screening
objects.description: Owns the decision to allow or hold a payment. It consumes risk signals and makes the decision explicit before ledger posting.

objects.title: Core ledger
objects.description: Owns the authoritative posting record. A repeated payment reference must not produce a second debit.

objects.title: Settlement hub
objects.description: Translates an internal payment into the external settlement contract. A delayed response needs status enquiry before any retry.

objects.title: Notification service
objects.description: Explains the payment outcome to the customer using the confirmed status. Notification failure does not reverse settlement.

objects.title: Payment service
objects.description: A candidate deployable service implementing the Payment API responsibility. Technology choices are illustrative.

objects.title: Risk engine
objects.description: Implements risk screening with a versioned ruleset and explicit allow or hold responses.

objects.title: Core connector
objects.description: Maps the posting contract to the core banking interface and carries the original payment reference.

objects.title: Settlement worker
objects.description: Executes the settlement handoff and enquires about uncertain outcomes before retrying.

objects.title: Notification worker
objects.description: Consumes outcome events and sends customer notifications independently of the settlement path.

objects.title: Application execution
objects.description: Execute application responsibilities within bounded, observable workloads.

objects.title: Transactional persistence
objects.description: Retain authoritative application state with explicit consistency and commit boundaries.

objects.title: Durable work handoff
objects.description: Carry acknowledged work and events across independently running components.

objects.title: Disposable read acceleration
objects.description: Reduce repeated reads while keeping the source of truth explicit.

objects.title: Service connectivity
objects.description: Route controlled requests between channels, application services, and external boundaries.

objects.title: Identity and access decisions
objects.description: Establish caller identity and enforce the authority to act at each protected boundary.

objects.title: Correlated operational evidence
objects.description: Retain and retrieve the evidence needed to explain behaviour across the payment journey.

objects.title: Recoverable state copies
objects.description: Preserve restorable copies with an explicit retention and integrity policy.

objects.title: Controlled service recovery
objects.description: Coordinate restoration and reconciliation before a service resumes financial work.

objects.title: Channel entry
objects.description: Authenticate the caller and authorise the instruction before crossing into payment services.

objects.title: Payment services
objects.description: Use explicit service identities and least-privilege access across component boundaries.

objects.title: Restricted state
objects.description: Restrict state and key access to named authorities; retain auditable access evidence.

objects.title: Payment instruction
objects.description: Stores the immutable customer instruction and its end-to-end reference.

objects.title: Ledger posting
objects.description: Links a unique payment reference to the authoritative debit or credit posting.

objects.title: Settlement status
objects.description: Records pending, settled, or failed state, including the external reference and reconciliation evidence.

objects.title: Initiating channel
objects.description: The customer-facing caller submits the instruction and retains its reference.

objects.title: Core banking authority
objects.description: The authoritative ledger records financial effects; the application adapter translates its contract.

objects.title: External payment network
objects.description: A placeholder for submission and enquiry boundaries. This is not an actual NPS or network specification.

objects.title: Identity & consent
objects.description: Checks the initiating identity and authority for the requested payment before processing.

objects.title: Audit trail
objects.description: Correlates decisions, postings, and settlement responses with a payment reference.

objects.title: Service trust
objects.description: Authenticates service-to-service communication across the external handoff.

objects.title: Payment without valid authority
objects.description: A caller submits or changes an instruction beyond the authority they hold.

objects.title: Repeated instruction changes the financial effect
objects.description: An original payment reference is replayed with changed business content or processed twice.

objects.title: Sensitive data escapes its intended audience
objects.description: Instruction or settlement details appear in a support view, export, or log beyond the approved purpose.

objects.title: Payment activity cannot be reconstructed
objects.description: A decision, posting, or enquiry cannot be linked to its actor and original payment reference.

objects.title: Initiate payment
objects.description: The customer provides a beneficiary and amount. The request receives a unique reference before processing begins.

objects.title: Screen for risk
objects.description: Evaluate the instruction against risk rules before allowing a debit. A flagged payment stops for review.

objects.title: Post ledger entry
objects.description: Record the debit with the payment reference. The model distinguishes the ledger posting from external settlement.

objects.title: Settle payment
objects.description: Send the authorised payment to the external settlement network and retain the response.

objects.title: Confirm outcome
objects.description: Notify the customer of the recorded outcome. A timeout remains pending until its status is reconciled.

rels.label: Allow
rels.condition: Only an explicit allow decision permits posting.
